id.description: Required non-null existing sine-source component ID from snapshot.components. Missing IDs and wrong kinds both return invalid-params. Selection and circuit completeness are not required.

waveform.description: Complete replacement definition. Every nested field is required and non-null, including zero values; omitted fields do not retain previous values. Quantity text normalizes before coupled model validation and retry matching.

preconditions: Ordinary protocol, revision/document, actor and retry admission guards apply
id names an existing sine-source; complete nested waveform satisfies individual and coupled normalized SI bounds
Incomplete drawings may be configured; successful editing does not guarantee a solvable circuit or a successful later simulation
effects: Replaces only the named source waveform; preserves its identity/kind, geometry, terminals/wires and other sources. component.value tracks sine amplitude or finite-pulse high voltage

An actual change is one ordinary undoable electrical edit; running simulation restarts from configured startup/time zero. Paused edits retain stale accepted readings/charge/time until Restart or Resume
Changed electrical configuration clears live scope cursors and window; independent recorded-view controls and captured rows are retained
Preserves experiment sample step/playback and other transient settings; sampling advice is recomputed from configured values. Fit sampling is a separate explicit command

Reapplying identical normalized numeric fields preserves graph, history, dirty state and physics; an ordinary successful command/actor revision may still advance. Equivalent unit/numeric retry intent normalizes before fingerprinting
Allowed in edit.batch against staged components; every edit commits together or the entire batch refuses. One undo restores the committed batch

Existing verification/recording rows and captured model/source parameters stay immutable; their source_unchanged becomes false when electrical revision changes. Saved projects retain numeric SI waveforms and the existing versioned model
Sine offset ± amplitude stays within ±12 V. Zero amplitude is a constant configured source, but frequency/phase bounds still apply

errors.when: Missing/unknown/duplicate/null fields, invalid quantities/units, nonfinite or coupled model bounds, missing source or wrong source kind. Waveform validation precedes target lookup; ordinary shared admission rules still apply

completion.mode: immediate validated graph commit; ordinary live initialization is asynchronous or deferred while paused

source.sine.set.x-source-inventory: snapshot.components filtered by kind sine-source; component.sine/pulse is configured data, while snapshot.mixed and transient describe the last accepted live result

urn:elab:waveform-quantity-Hz:1.description: Finite numeric value or decimal/scientific quantity text; bare text uses Hz. Model/coupled bounds apply after conversion. No hexadecimal, NaN, Inf or nonzero underflow.

urn:elab:waveform-quantity-V:1.description: Finite numeric value or decimal/scientific quantity text; bare text uses V. Model/coupled bounds apply after conversion. No hexadecimal, NaN, Inf or nonzero underflow.

urn:elab:waveform-quantity-deg:1.description: Finite numeric value or decimal/scientific quantity text; bare text uses deg. Model/coupled bounds apply after conversion. No hexadecimal, NaN, Inf or nonzero underflow.

checks: Exact decimal waveform quantities retain binary64 values; numeric re-entry preserves history/physics
Voltage, frequency, phase and time input share public commands; numeric compatibility and typed local references retained
Wrong units, underflow, null and coupled model violations refuse without mutation
Sine and finite-ramp RC transients agree with independent first-order references within existing 3 mV envelope
Every captured sine/ramp source sample agrees with independent analytic waveform
Saved waveform fields stay numeric SI and save/reopen preserves exact configured values and bytes
limits: Quantity text is command-only; persisted data and outputs stay numeric SI
Existing model and integration/work limits still apply; no physical device or complete mounted typing/IME/accessibility/latency qualification
